Our story

The care your home deserves

“Exceptional care and meticulous detail for your peace of mind.” At Martins Professional Cleaning LLC, we believe a clean environment goes far beyond appearance — a well-maintained home or business brings comfort, tranquility, health and well-being to your whole family or team.

As a family-oriented business located in Ohio, our dedication is to deliver residential and commercial cleaning with excellence, reliability and extreme attention to detail. Unlike large franchises, we value a personal touch — every cleaning is personally performed by our stable, trustworthy team, so each client receives the same meticulous standard on every visit.

— Liliane Martins, owner
